pr_title: [Merged by Bors] - Add QueryState::get_single_unchecked_manual and its family
pr_body:
# Objective

- Rebase of #3159.
- Fixes https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/3156
- add #[inline] to single related functions so that they matches with other function defs

## Solution

* added functions to QueryState
  *  get_single_unchecked_manual
  *  get_single_unchecked
  *  get_single
  *  get_single_mut
  *  single
  *  single_mut
* make Query::get_single use QueryState::get_single_unchecked_manual
* added #[inline]

---

## Changelog

### Added

Functions `QueryState::single`, `QueryState::get_single`, `QueryState::single_mut`, `QueryState::get_single_mut`, `QueryState::get_single_unchecked`, `QueryState::get_single_unchecked_manual`.

### Changed

`QuerySingleError` is now in the `state` module.

## Migration Guide

Change `query::QuerySingleError` to `state::QuerySingleError`

issue_context.title: Add single() to QueryState
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

Currently `Query` have a convenient [single()](https://docs.rs/bevy/0.5.0/bevy/ecs/prelude/struct.Query.html#method.single) function. But [QueryState](https://docs.rs/bevy/0.5.0/bevy/ecs/query/struct.QueryState.html) doesn't

## What solution would you like?

Move `single()` logic to `QueryState` and call it from `Query`.
comments:
This should be trivial to implement. For any newcomers: this is a nice way to get familiar with a tiny bit of the ECS internals and our contributing process.

Note that you'll also want to move `.single_mut`.

review_comments: This change shouldn't be needed; what happens if you remove it?
@alice-i-cecile Compilation error that I mentioned in Discord. @BoxyUwU suggested this fix for it.
for future context `&'w Q` requires `Q: 'w` to hold which is unnecessary, this change makes that not required
